newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Sun Air privatisation bids 90-140 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Sun Air privatisation bids 90-140 mln rand.

text.p: The South African government received non-binding bids of 90-140 million rand for the 100 percent privatisation of domestic carrier Sun Air, Transport Minister Mac Maharaj said on Monday.
Selected bidders had been asked to enter binding bids by July 21 but this had been extended by two weeks at the request of the bidders, Maharaj told Reuters after a news briefing.
Maharaj said he expected the privatisation process to be completed within two months.
"I'd to complete that well before the end of the year -- a month or two should be long enough," he said.

Malaysia Airlines Consortium, Bhekilanga Consortium, Comair Consortium and Phoenix Venture Partners Consortium were shortlisted as bidders for the airline which operates eight aircraft on routes between Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
Virgin Atlantic withdrew from the bidding last month and his since expressed interest in acquiring a stake in South African Airways, which the government aims to part privatise.
